stories.label: Iran-US-Israel war: missile hits US consul in Israel, athletes dropping asylum bids
stories.summary: Day 24: Iranian missile fragment struck US consul residence in Israel - first confirmed hit on US diplomatic facility. Iranian football captain drops asylum bid, latest in pattern of athletes returning during wartime. War continuing with no coalition forming for Hormuz escort despite Trump pressure on Japan/NATO.

stories.label: Hormuz crisis: US escort coalition fails as allies refuse; Japan constitutional trap; Bitcoin decorrelates
stories.summary: Trump called for international naval escort and was met with broad refusal. Japan caught between 90% oil dependence on Hormuz and Article 9 pacifist constitution. Bitcoin holding at 71K while equities crash - genuine decorrelation or capital flight from war-zone fiat? IEA reserves at one-third. No military or diplomatic solution emerging.

stories.label: Lebanon-Israel-Palestine: settler impunity policy enables family killing, Gaza bombardment invisible
stories.summary: Haaretz documents systematic impunity framework for settlers and soldiers in West Bank - loosened ROE under war emergency. Odeh family (mother, father, two children) killed. Gaza: 13 killed March 15 including children and pregnant woman, zero international attention. Aid crossings sealed since March 1. 850,000+ displaced in Lebanon, talks announced but strikes continue.

stories.label: Sudan: RSF drone campaign, cross-border violence into South Sudan, 169 killed
stories.summary: Sudan war metastasising: RSF drone campaign targeting civilian markets, convoys and student populations. Armed RSF militias crossed into South Sudan killing 169. Darfur starvation documented as war crime. War barely covered internationally due to Iran war dominance. Sudan army recapturing territory (Bara) but drone campaign spreading the conflict.

stories.label: Pakistan: Austerity spiral — 4-day work week, school closures, IMF failure, Ramadan energy cuts
stories.summary: Pakistan facing triple crisis: Hormuz fuel shock, existing debt spiral, and Ramadan. Four-day work week, school closures, IMF talks collapsed, gas cuts during sehri/iftar. Kerosene price hiked Rs 40 hitting the poorest. Underlying story of a nuclear state in economic collapse, invisible in Western media.

stories.label: Hungary: Orbán faces first serious challenger in Peter Magyar
stories.summary: Orbán and Magyar held parallel rallies on March 15 national day. Most competitive Hungarian election in 14 years. Magyar has built cross-ideological coalition.

stories.label: AI-generated war disinformation: fake satellite imagery, paid unlabeled footage, deepfakes
stories.summary: Recurring theme across the week: AI disinformation becoming a structural feature of wartime information. Fake satellite imagery circulating about Iran strikes. X paid creators for unlabeled war footage. AI chatbots failing to block mass-violence planning. Meta AI generating CSAM/deepfakes. Disinformation infrastructure now industrialised.

stories.label: China resumes large-scale military flights near Taiwan with US assets committed to Gulf
stories.summary: PLA resumes large-scale flights near Taiwan with US carrier groups committed to Gulf. Timing unmistakably opportunistic. First major PLA activity in the Taiwan Strait since Iran war began.

stories.label: French far right strong in municipal elections round 1 — 2027 preview
stories.summary: RN performs strongly in round 1 of French municipal elections. Building local government base historically absent. Round 2 expected ~March 22.

stories.label: SEC and CFTC joint crypto regulatory MOU — turf war ends
stories.summary: SEC and CFTC sign MOU ending years of regulatory turf war over digital assets. Alongside NYSE/Nasdaq blockchain move and BlackRock staked ether ETF — signals US formalising crypto infrastructure.

stories.label: NYSE and Nasdaq moving $126 trillion equity market to blockchain
stories.summary: Both major US exchange operators moving toward blockchain settlement. Structural shift in financial infrastructure, not just cryptocurrency speculation.

stories.label: 404 Media maps full US surveillance stack: Flock to ICE
stories.summary: Comprehensive mapping of US surveillance infrastructure from license plate readers to ICE integration. Part of broader domestic security architecture building alongside Iran war. DOGE testimony on federal data access same week.

stories.label: BioNTech founders Şahin and Türeci leave to start new venture
stories.summary: COVID mRNA vaccine pioneers leaving BioNTech to start new biotech. Signals next phase of mRNA platform development.

stories.label: Kenya: Severe flooding kills 66+ outside normal rainy season
stories.summary: Escalating from 42 to 66+ dead. Flooding outside normal rainy season — climate signal. Ethiopia same week: 100+ dead in floods and landslides.

stories.label: South Africa deploys 2,200 soldiers to 5 provinces — unusual domestic scale
stories.summary: Unusual scale of domestic military deployment. Context: GDP contraction, crime crisis, energy insecurity from Hormuz.

stories.label: Bellingcat releases Turnstone flight tracking OSINT tool
stories.summary: New investigative tool for historical and spatial flight data. Democratises MH17/sanctions-busting methodology for the war context. Also: Bellingcat satellite imagery of Iranian police station strikes published same week.

stories.label: Pre-Inca elites traded parrots across Andes centuries before road system
stories.summary: Archaeological isotope analysis reveals pre-Inca Peruvian elites imported macaws from Amazon across Andes before any known infrastructure. Rewrites timeline of Andean long-distance trade.

stories.label: Forensic bryology: moss used as courtroom evidence to convict grave robbers
stories.summary: Moss species used as forensic evidence in Chicago cemetery grave robbery case. Novel application of bryology as hyperlocal environmental fingerprint in criminal prosecution.

stories.label: China building domestic photoresist to break US-Japan semiconductor chokepoint
stories.summary: China targeting photoresist - one of last Western chokepoints in chip supply chain. Follows pattern of ASML lithography workarounds. JSR and Tokyo Ohka duopoly under threat.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan: Cross-border strikes into Taliban territory
stories.summary: Pakistan struck deep inside Afghanistan. Overshadowed by Iran war. No significant international response.

stories.label: Vanuatu newspaper banned from football coverage over 'lesbianism' headline
stories.summary: Pacific press freedom and LGBTQ rights: newspaper punished by football federation for headline about women players' sexual orientation.

stories.label: Signet: open-source autonomous wildfire tracking from satellite data
stories.summary: Open-source wildfire tracking tool using satellite imagery and weather models.

stories.label: South Korea-Finland quantum computing and 6G research partnership
stories.summary: Two mid-size tech democracies deepening research ties outside US-China axis.

stories.label: Materials science of tongues sticking to frozen metal - thermal conductivity explainer
stories.summary: Ars Technica explainer on physics of tissue adhesion to frozen metal - thermal conductivity, saliva crystallization, material differences.

stories.label: C++26 Oxford variadic comma resolves decades-old syntax inconsistency
stories.summary: C++26 standardizes trailing commas in variadic templates. Minor syntax change to language powering OS, games, embedded systems, HFT.

stories.label: UK bans pro-Palestinian march — civil liberties crackdown during war
stories.summary: UK government preemptively banned Al Quds Day march and later a pro-Palestinian march; hundreds defied ban, 12 arrested. Pattern: wartime civil liberties erosion in Western democracies.

stories.label: Chile Kast inauguration; Latin America right-bloc forming as Lula boycotts
stories.summary: Chile's far-right Kast inaugurated with 90-day emergency government plan. Lula boycotted inauguration over Bolsonaro's presence. Ecuador deepening Trump-style criminal crackdown on economy. Latin America splitting between right-populist bloc and progressive governments.

stories.label: North Korea: Cruise missile destroyer test, NK-Iran nuclear cooperation, crypto sanctions evasion
stories.summary: North Korea testing cruise missile destroyer, reportedly cooperating with Iran on missile/nuclear technology during war, and running crypto IT-worker schemes to fund weapons. Proliferation risk heightened during US focus on Gulf.
